_comment: Seed rule table (Plan 5, Task 3). A living document — a handful of real, checkable rules pulled from this repo's own CLAUDE.md/planning docs (the only concrete style source in this worktree; the target repo's own AGENTS.md/best-practices supersede this seed once available there), not placeholders. Each rule is file-glob-scoped so rule-check.ts only asks about hunks it actually applies to.

rules.description: No `any` types in TypeScript — every new type must be concrete or generic, never `any`.
Zod schemas are PascalCase with a `Schema` suffix (e.g. `BriefScopeInputSchema`).
Every `aw:*` hook must fail open (allow, or a silent exit 0) on a judge/sqlite failure — never block the user's agents by throwing or hanging.
Every `aw:*` hook starts with `[ -n "${AW_JUDGE_CHILD:-}" ] && exit 0` and is tagged `# aw:<name>` in its installed settings.json entry.
One logical change per commit; commit messages use `type: short description`.
`setup.sh`/install scripts never remove hook entries they don't own — always go through `merge_hook`, never edit settings.json by hand.
